faq.question: Does it cost anything to ask?
faq.answer: No. Describing your goal and getting an initial solution map is free. If a paid tool or custom build makes sense, we'll tell you upfront.

faq.question: Do I need to know which AI tool I need?
faq.answer: No. Just describe the outcome you want in plain English. We figure out whether an existing tool or a custom setup fits best.

faq.question: Who is this for?
faq.answer: Small and medium businesses in Saskatchewan and across Western Canada that want practical AI help without the enterprise jargon.

heroTitle: Tell us what you want AI to do for your business.
heroSub: You don't need to know the tool, the jargon, or the tech. Just describe the outcome you want in plain English. We'll map out a practical solution — using tools that already exist, or a custom setup built for you.

steps.title: Describe it
steps.text: In the box below, tell us the annoying task, the goal, or the "I wish AI could…" in your own words. One sentence or ten — whatever it takes.

steps.title: We map it
steps.text: We match your goal to the right approach — an off-the-shelf tool, a simple automation, or a custom build. Honest about what's worth paying for.

steps.title: You decide
steps.text: You get a plain-language plan back. Run it yourself, or have us set it up. No pressure, no obligation — asking is free.

intake.title: What do you want AI to do?
intake.description: Be as specific or as vague as you like. Real examples: "Stop me chasing late invoices," "Show up when people ask ChatGPT for a Regina electrician," "Turn my one blog post into a week of social posts."
intake.describeLabel: What do you want AI to do for your business?
intake.describePlaceholder: Describe the task, goal, or problem in your own words…
intake.describeHint: The more detail, the better the solution we can map for you.
intake.emailHint: So we can send your solution map back. We never sell your info.
intake.consentLabel: Also send me The AI Collective Weekly — one plain-English AI email every Thursday. Unsubscribe anytime. (Optional)

items.question: Does it cost anything to ask?
items.answer: No. Describing your goal and getting an initial solution map is free. If a paid tool or custom build makes sense, we'll tell you upfront — no surprises.

items.question: Do I need to know which tool I need?
items.answer: Not at all. Just describe the outcome you want. Figuring out the right tool or setup is our job, not yours.

items.question: Who's this for?
items.answer: Small and medium businesses in Saskatchewan and across Western Canada that want practical AI help without enterprise jargon or a big budget.

items.question: What happens to my info?
items.answer: Your description comes straight to us so we can reply. We never sell your data, and you only join the newsletter if you tick the box.
